segments.source: Sava nu adăugă că uneori un lucru putea funcționa și totuși să distrugă persoana care îl făcuse. Copilul avea să afle destul de devreme.
segments.translation: Sava did not add that sometimes a thing could work and still destroy the person who had done it. The child would learn that soon enough.

segments.source: La ieșire, un funcționar îi ceru să valideze cauza instituțională a morții. Pe ecran apărea din nou „eliberare biologică accidentală”. Sava deschise câmpul blocat și își folosi rangul de urgență.
segments.translation: On the way out, an official asked her to validate the institutional cause of death. “Accidental biological release” appeared on the screen again. Sava opened the locked field and used her emergency rank.

segments.source: — Ce scrii? întrebă Oru.
segments.translation: “What are you writing?” Oru asked.

segments.source: — „Deces prin protecție în incident de mulțime.”
segments.translation: “Death through protection in a crowd incident.”

segments.source: — Este o categorie nouă.
segments.translation: “That’s a new category.”

segments.source: — Acum există.
segments.translation: “It exists now.”

segments.source: Funcționarul își plie velele, neliniștit.
segments.translation: The official folded his sails uneasily.

segments.source: — Dacă separăm cauzele, compensațiile vor fi contestate. Familiile celor striviți pot cere răspundere pentru gestionarea pieței, nu doar pentru eliberarea animalului.
segments.translation: “If we separate the causes, the compensation will be contested. The families of those crushed can demand accountability for the management of the square, not just for the animal’s release.”

segments.source: — Pot cere.
segments.translation: “They can.”

segments.source: — Camera va trebui să deschidă anchete.
segments.translation: “The Chamber will have to open inquiries.”

segments.source: — Atunci va deschide.
segments.translation: “Then it will.”

segments.source: Pe drumul înapoi, trecură prin Piața Joasă. Apa de spălare fusese evacuată, tarabele ridicate, crăpăturile podelei acoperite cu rășină. Un grup de muncitori reinstala plăcile Festivalului pentru ceremonia de doliu. Pe una dintre ele rămăsese imprimată urma unui corp; rășina o făcuse lucioasă. Supraveghetorul ordonă să fie șlefuită.
segments.translation: On the way back, they passed through Low Square. The wash water had been drained, the stalls put up, the cracks in the floor covered with resin. A group of workers was reinstalling the Festival panels for the mourning ceremony. The imprint of a body remained on one of them; the resin had made it shine. The supervisor ordered it sanded down.

segments.source: Sava se opri până când urma dispăru.
segments.translation: Sava stopped until the trace disappeared.

segments.source: — Mâine, spuse Oru, oamenii vor traversa locul fără să știe unde a fost.
segments.translation: “Tomorrow,” Oru said, “people will cross this place without knowing where it was.”

segments.source: — Trebuie să poată traversa.
segments.translation: “They have to be able to cross.”

segments.source: — Asta nu înseamnă că trebuie să uite.
segments.translation: “That doesn’t mean they have to forget.”

segments.source: Sava privi muncitorul care aspira praful rezultat. Capitala era foarte bună la diferența dintre refacere și memorie. Refăcea imediat. Memoria o păstra sub niveluri la care publicul nu avea acces.
segments.translation: Sava watched the worker vacuuming up the dust. The capital was very good at the distinction between restoration and memory. It restored immediately. It kept memory beneath levels the public could not access.

segments.source: Când se întoarse la birou, schimbarea introdusă de ea se propagase deja prin sistem. Treizeci și șase de dosare așteptau reclasificarea. Fiecare familie avea acum dreptul de a întreba nu doar ce declanșase incidentul, ci ce anume îi omorâse persoana.
segments.translation: When she returned to the office, the change she had introduced had already propagated through the system. Thirty-six files awaited reclassification. Each family now had the right to ask not only what had triggered the incident, but what had actually killed their person.

segments.source: — Tocmai ai transformat o statistică în treizeci și șapte de anchete, spuse Oru.
segments.translation: “You’ve just turned a statistic into thirty-seven inquiries,” Oru said.

segments.source: — Nu. Erau treizeci și șapte înainte să le număr eu.
segments.translation: “No. There were thirty-seven before I counted them.”

segments.source: Ușa se deschise.
segments.translation: The door opened.

segments.source: Ușa se deschise. Taren intră fără să ceară voie. Umărul îi fusese bandajat, iar blana de pe piept îi era încă umedă de la decontaminare. Purta în mână o bucată de material negru, nu mai mare decât o frunză.
segments.translation: The door opened. Taren came in without asking permission. His shoulder had been bandaged, and the fur on his chest was still damp from decontamination. In his hand he carried a piece of black material no larger than a leaf.

segments.source: Sava se ridică.
segments.translation: Sava stood.

segments.source: — De unde o ai?
segments.translation: “Where did you get that?”

segments.source: — De pe membrană. A rămas prinsă în bandaj.
segments.translation: “From the membrane. It got caught in the bandage.”

segments.source: — Trebuie predată laboratorului.
segments.translation: “It has to be handed over to the laboratory.”

segments.source: — Laboratorul știe deja ce este.
segments.translation: “The laboratory already knows what it is.”

segments.source: Așeză bucata pe birou. La lumină, nu părea puf, ci o rețea de filamente subțiri, fiecare terminată într-un cârlig microscopic.
segments.translation: He laid the piece on the desk. In the light, it looked less like down than a network of fine filaments, each ending in a microscopic hook.

segments.source: — Seln spune că a scăpat dintr-o instalație, continuă Taren. Agenții spun că nu există alte exemplare. Medicul a spus că specia nu se poate reproduce în climatul nostru.
segments.translation: “Seln says it escaped from a facility,” Taren continued. “The agents say there are no other specimens. The doctor said the species can’t reproduce in our climate.”

segments.source: — Și?
segments.translation: “And?”

segments.source: — Avea lapte în țesuturile ventrale.
segments.translation: “There was milk in its ventral tissues.”

segments.source: Oru se apropie.
segments.translation: Oru came closer.

segments.source: — Era femelă?
segments.translation: “Was it female?”

segments.source: — Hrănea ceva.
segments.translation: “It was feeding something.”

segments.source: Camera deveni foarte tăcută. În perete, rețeaua radiculară pompa apă cu un ritm lent, aproape organic.
segments.translation: The room became very quiet. In the wall, the root network pumped water with a slow, almost organic rhythm.

segments.source: Sava întinse mâna spre fragment, dar nu-l atinse.
segments.translation: Sava reached towards the fragment but did not touch it.

segments.source: — Poate fi o reacție hormonală indusă în laborator.
segments.translation: “It could be a hormonal reaction induced in the laboratory.”

segments.source: — Poate, spuse Taren.
segments.translation: “It could,” Taren said.

segments.source: — Atunci de ce ai venit?
segments.translation: “Then why have you come?”

segments.source: Taren își întoarse capul spre harta Dungii. Lumina roșie a punctelor i se reflecta în ochii laterali, astfel încât părea că privește simultan lumea și ceva din afara ei.
segments.translation: Taren turned his head towards the map of the Belt. The points of red light reflected in his lateral eyes, so that he seemed to be looking at the world and at something outside it at the same time.

segments.source: — Pentru că atunci când am împins tija, am auzit două bătăi sub podea.
segments.translation: “Because when I pushed the rod, I heard two beats beneath the floor.”

segments.source: Sava simți cum velele i se ridică singure.
segments.translation: Sava felt her sails rise on their own.

segments.source: — Ce fel de bătăi?
segments.translation: “What kind of beats?”

segments.source: — Nu de la mulțime. De jos. Una, apoi alta. Ca un răspuns.
segments.translation: “Not from the crowd. From below. One, then another. Like an answer.”

segments.source: — Conductele vibrează.
segments.translation: “The pipes vibrate.”

segments.source: — Știu cum vibrează conductele.
segments.translation: “I know how pipes vibrate.”

segments.source: Oru își puse palma pe podea.
segments.translation: Oru laid his palm on the floor.

segments.source: — Sub piață sunt rezervoarele vechi ale muzeului genetic.
segments.translation: “The genetic museum’s old tanks are beneath the square.”

segments.source: Sava se uită la el.
segments.translation: Sava looked at him.

segments.source: — Au fost golite acum optzeci de ani.
segments.translation: “They were emptied eighty years ago.”

segments.source: — Așa scrie în registre.
segments.translation: “That’s what the registers say.”

segments.source: Taren zâmbi pentru prima dată după atac. Era un zâmbet mic, aproape rușinat, dar dălțile albe se văzură din nou.
segments.translation: Taren smiled for the first time since the attack. It was a small, almost embarrassed smile, but the white chisel teeth showed again.

segments.source: — Atunci registrele ar trebui să fugă primele, spuse el.
segments.translation: “Then the registers should be the first to run,” he said.

segments.source: Loviturile din rezervor nu fură auzite de public. Senzorii nivelului inferior le înregistrară și le clasificară drept dilatare structurală. Un operator obosit confirmă clasificarea fără să deschidă forma de undă.
segments.translation: The blows in the tank were not heard by the public. The lower-level sensors recorded them and classified them as structural expansion. A tired operator confirmed the classification without opening the waveform.

segments.source: Taren, Sava și Oru coborâră totuși până la primul sigiliu. Nu aveau acces mai jos. Galeria era îngustă, cu pereți vechi de aliaj, iar luminile se aprindeau târziu, lăsând întunericul să alerge înaintea lor.
segments.translation: Taren, Sava and Oru nevertheless went down as far as the first seal. They had no access below it. The gallery was narrow, its walls made of old alloy, and the lights came on late, letting the darkness run ahead of them.

segments.source: Taren puse palma pe ușă. Nimic.
segments.translation: Taren laid his palm on the door. Nothing.

segments.source: — Poate ai auzit ecoul luptei, spuse Sava.
segments.translation: “Perhaps you heard the echo of the struggle,” Sava said.

segments.source: — Poate.
segments.translation: “Perhaps.”

segments.source: — Sau un mecanism de aerisire.
segments.translation: “Or a ventilation mechanism.”

segments.source: — Poate.
segments.translation: “Perhaps.”
